articles.summary: In an increasingly volatile world, global companies are making decisions and investments to build resilience and flexibility. One key strategy is moving production closer to end consumers—nearshoring production—and in Northern America, we see Mexico benefiting significantly. This Prologis Research report examines the long- and short-term impacts of nearshoring on demand for Mexican logistics real estate.
articles.title: Impacts of Nearshoring on Demand for Mexican Logistics Real Estate
